prompts.hero-motion-mage:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game animation sprite atlas, transparent alpha. The supplied hero.png is EXACT identity and rendering reference: brown tousled hair, cream leaf hair clip, amber eyes, cream scarf, dark forest green tunic with gold piping, brown gloves belts pouch boots, sage green cape, chibi 2.5-head proportions and richly shaded illustrated pixel-like edges. New actions. EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows, square canvas. Each animation occupies TWO rows = 8 consecutive frames reading left to right. Full character with ample transparent margins in every cell. Consistent size, camera and LEFT facing. Feet planted around same local origin; NO horizontal travel, NO vertical root motion. Full body and weapons fit each cell; no bleed into neighbor. No text, grid, ground, shadows, background, large glow, motion smear or duplicated limbs. Show clean silhouettes, visible hand contact and connected sequential poses with anticipation, action, recovery. First and last frames of EACH action use SAME neutral ready pose. Keep weapons identical size and design within every frame. Do not draw a sword or scabbard from reference: equip only the requested class weapon.
Weapon: ONE slender walnut staff with brass leaf cage and small teal crystal, staff height approximately character height. Right hand always encloses same staff shaft grip, no floating staff.
TOP 8 FRAMES: focused spell cast: 1 staff held diagonally at side, left palm low ready; 2 draw left palm to chest; 3 cup palm close to crystal gathering a tiny teal spark; 4 rotate left wrist outward; 5 extend open left palm LEFT releasing one small spark (not a projectile beam); 6 follow through open palm; 7 withdraw hand; 8 ready.
BOTTOM 8 FRAMES: staff burst: 1 same ready; 2 bring staff upright; 3 both hands grip staff; 4 raise staff diagonally overhead; 5 thrust staff head diagonally left with tiny crystal flash; 6 recoil elbows; 7 lower staff; 8 identical ready. Character never relocates.
